in_hebrew.name: Estas
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Estas הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'astéros', meaning 'star'. In Greek mythology, the stars were considered divine and represented various gods and goddesses. The name Estas can be given to a girl as a symbol of divine light, guidance, or inspiration.
